BA Launchpad

Eight weeks. A small group. A structured route into business analysis, taught live by a practising BA, with your work reviewed along the way.

Who it's for

  • Career changers moving into business analysis from operations, finance, HR, customer service or project roles
  • New and junior BAs who want a proper foundation instead of learning by trial and error
  • Data analysts and project managers adding business analysis to their toolkit

What you'll leave with

  • The core BA techniques, practised on realistic cases rather than read about
  • Requirements and process models you can show in interviews
  • A CV and LinkedIn profile positioned for BA roles
  • Interview answers rehearsed until they're natural

Why a small group

You learn faster alongside people facing the same challenge, and a small cohort means every participant gets direct feedback, not a pre-recorded video and a forum.

Interested in the next cohort?

Book a free 30-minute call. We'll check BA Launchpad is right for you, and you'll be first to hear when the next cohort opens.
